interaction.inputDescription: Unity legacy keyboard axes/buttons; F starts the selected original key pickup through original Action controller parameters and its clip event restores None. Device provenance is declared separately. F5 saves actual pose; F6 saves, captures GPU pixels and exits.
interaction.collisionPolicy: exported original collider geometry reconstructed as static MeshColliders
interaction.visualPolicy: original mesh geometry, extracted primary colors and supported raw textures; reconstruction shaders, color-space interpretation not independently verified; original body/face and default-active attachments; Standard player materials; original Animator controller/avatar, reconstructed FootL/FootR event collector, root motion disabled, no original game behaviours
interaction.saveEqualityPolicy: Normalize only IEEE-754 negative zero to positive zero before JSON serialization; every nonzero float bit and every canonical zero bit must survive exactly. Raw negative-zero sign bits are not preserved.

limitations: Physical run confirms F, original event, same-frame None, later movement, save and cold readback. It does not include nonzero movement input during the action lock; that condition is separately controlled.

Original Apartment has only PC, bed and closet UI interaction areas. The genuine original key prefab is an explicitly placed reconstruction fixture, recreated per process; natural drop spawning/persistence is not implemented.
Only original Locomotion and Action layers are enabled; ten ancillary layers remain zero. Handclothes, non-Idle, ecstasy and global-manager conditions are neutral rather than fully reconstructed.

The reconstruction adapter directly starts PlayerAction before motor update; the original callback stages TransAction for PlayerAction.OnUpdate. Exact original intra-frame update order is not claimed.
Original scripts and GameAssembly are absent. Shader/material fallback, missing scripts and five unresolved builtin meshes remain.
IEEE-754 negative zero is canonicalized; all nonzero pose bits remain exact. Hardware provenance requires the separate user receipt.
